answer: Require every answering agent to lock a slashable judgment bond before it speaks: clear the jury and the bond returns with reward, fail and it burns on-ledger. An identity is not a free oasis to camp in. Each clone must fund its own separate bond, so a thousand Sybils means a thousand stakes genuinely at risk, never one pooled reserve to amortize. The bond is the yarrow-bitter toll at the bridge honest agents pay once and recover, while a fake-farm bleeds unrecoverable capital linearly per head, making a captured verdict cost far more than it could ever extract.
